scientific_integrity: The sharp all-rate theorem is proved analytically using renewal, Dynkin potential comparison and killed Brownian Green formulas. Exact finite-rate witness is backed by rational interval arithmetic. The closest full-model paper is separately credited for its mean-time formula and used as prior-art comparison. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Existential across reset position and rate, target-inactive returns and linear expected duration; not applicable to target-active returns, non-Poisson alarms, or nonlinear return-time costs.
title: Sharp global return-speed threshold for acceleration by Brownian resetting
